column1: Everquest is blocked by the University firewall
column2: The UC Davis network is continually scanned for prohibited activities and network threats.
column3: Sony Playstation 2 is allowed by the University firewall
column4: POP3 and secure POP are allowed by the University firewall
column5: ACT/IT Infrastructure monitors traffic on the network for the purpose of maintaining proper network function
column6: University Housing monitors only the amount of traffic
column7: Quotas for students are 5000 Megabyte per hr download and 2000 Megabyte per hr upload
column8: CounterStrike server is blocked by the University firewall
column9: HTTP and HTTPS are allowed by the University firewall
column10: If a student is in obvious violations of copyright law by using a room's wired connection (ie ResNet) to distribute copyrighted materials, the room's connection will be disabled, and the issue could be sent to Housing Student Judicial Affairs
column11: Telnet is allowed by the University firewall
column12: There is a 6 GB per 24-hour period upload or download data transfer limit starting at midnight of each day, on all of your combined traffic on ResNet and UIC wireless
